[quote=br_bob;59934297]You guys call them chips? Oh I thought that was an American thing what do you call what we call chips (fries or something)?[/quote]
We call both the computer part and the thin slices of fried potato by the same name, Chips
But we will add a extra word to specify if we feel its needed (usualy when there is a lack of context) so we have 'Potato Chips' and 'Computer Chips', (we ofcorse have more words for potato chips to give more spesification, or less if you not used to them XD, like 'Potatogold' for the most classic type of potato chips :P )

[quote=feyria;59934503]We call both the computer part and the thin slices of fried potato by the same name, Chips
But we will add a extra word to specify if we feel its needed (usualy when there is a lack of context) so we have 'Potato Chips' and 'Computer Chips', (we ofcorse have more words for potato chips to give more spesification, or less if you not used to them XD, like 'Potatogold' for the most classic type of potato chips :P )[/quote]
Potatogold, no offense, sounds Irish personally you have Walkers up there right?

[quote=br_bob;59934764]Potatogold, no offense, sounds Irish personally you have Walkers up there right? [/quote]
We do, but only in more expensive shops that deal in either foreign stuff, high quality food or on online stores, I know that you can find 'Walkers Pure Butter Shortbread' in the quality grocery shop called 'MENY', but in the more common and low price grocery shops you will proberly not find any of their stuff.

We also have a few different words for what you british people call Chips(Fries)
We have Pommes Frites (or the shortened name Pomfri) for the ones you get from fast food resturants like Mc Donalds
While we do know what the name 'French Fry' are a word for them we use that one for a spesific type of Chips/Crisps that look like a French Fry/Chips/Pommes Frites
and ofcorse we also have the pure norwegian word "Opphøgde Poteter"(Choped up potatoes) that we usualy use for the type that you are suposed to bake in the oven.
Many of us will also understand what you mean if you ask for 'Fries' as we get a lot of american entertainment here.

We also have more spesific names for the special ones to ofcorse, like 'Potetbåter'(Potatoboats) for the one cut in a boat like shape :D
